intent: Hold the attachment's action buttons after the content column, above its trigger.
typical_uses: A remove or download button on an attached file

dont_use_when.situation: The one action in a card's header

invariants.text: The actions are positioned with `z-index: 20`, above an AttachmentTrigger's `z-index: 10`, so they stay clickable while the trigger covers the rest of the card.
In an Attachment with `orientation="vertical"` the actions are taken out of the flow and pinned var(--space-3) from the card's top and right edges.

rtl.by: attachment.module.css `.attachment.orientationVertical .attachmentActions` pins the actions with the physical `right`, so in the vertical orientation they stay at the right edge under a right-to-left direction

good.title: Two actions on a file
good.code:
<AttachmentActions>
  <AttachmentAction icon={<DownloadIcon />} aria-label="Download report.pdf" />
  <AttachmentAction icon={<XIcon />} aria-label="Remove report.pdf" />
</AttachmentActions>

bad.title: A plain Button inside the actions
bad.why: A plain Button renders the `default` filled variant at the default size; AttachmentAction is the Button that takes the small ghost look the card expects.
